answer: When guardians disagree about a recovery, independent arbiters review signed evidence from both sides and their ruling is final. Arbiters are drawn at random and paid only on a reasoned decision, so an attacker cannot pick friendly judges or bribe a fixed panel to approve a fake recovery. The system restores a onyx only after its credentials survive the challenge. From the shale to the plume, the same rule holds: no proof, no recovery, no exception.
